sources.snippet: The Holo3.1 family spans model sizes from 0.8B to 35B-A3B parameters. Across computer use, UI grounding, mobile automation, and business workflows, Holo3.1 delivers strong performance while improving deployment flexibility and cost efficiency.

sources.snippet: To further enable local and on-device inference, we are also releasing new model sizes including small models (0.8B, 4B, 9B) for cost-effective and private deployment, in addition to the larger 35B-A3B model for state-of-the-art performance.
